Name: Gourmand Frog 1.6 Restoration
Author: TreeBert
Description:
Some may not even have noticed, i myself did not notice it in my first 1.6 playthrough, but the dialogue of the Gourmand Frog on Ginger Island was changed in the latest big update to Stardew Valley. He used to speak in a Jamaican accent and use words such as "bombo big" and "ding-ee small" etc, but that could apparently be perceived as stereotypical and/or offensive by some individuals. Version 1.6 changed his lines to make him speak regular english, while also adding more precise instructions for completing his mini-quest. While i appreciated the clearer instructions, i did feel a slight reduction in overall enjoyment caused by the lack of funny language.

This mod simply copies the old dialogue lines from version 1.5.6 and pastes them into the latest version of the game. It only affects the English language option currently, since i don't know the other languages and can't tell if or how they have changed. It's my first mod ever, but it seems to be working and it shouldn't cause any problems since it only replaces some specific text lines. Just put it in the Mods folder and make sure you have Content Patcher installed, that should be it.
